inside_holding_window: major central-bank rate decision in 12 sessions
events.coverage: scheduled events tracked: central-bank rate decisions only

vol_surface.term_structure: contango: 30-day implied volatility below 90-day implied volatility
vol_surface.iv_vs_realized: iv_fair: implied volatility about equal to recent realized volatility

iv_rank_1y.bucket: low: 20 to 40 percent of the way from the past year's low to its high

levels.distance_from_52w_high: near_high: within 2 percent of the 1-year high

range.move_today: advance: rose about a normal day's move
range.gap_today: none: opened near the prior close
range.realized_vol_change: contracting: last week's swings smaller than the past month's

realized_vol_20d_pctile_1y.bucket: upper_middle: 60th to 80th percentile of the past year

consecutive_closes.bucket: no_streak: no run of closes in one direction

distance_from_20d_avg_in_atr.bucket: extended_above: price moderately above its 20-day average

trend.strength: strong: the 20-day move is large relative to normal daily swings
trend.direction: up: price above rising 20-day and 50-day averages

market.tail_skew_index: normal: middle of the past year's range
market.vol_of_vol: normal: middle of the past year's range
market.near_term_stress: neutral: 9-day and 30-day implied volatility about equal
market.vol_term_structure: contango: 30-day implied volatility below 3-month implied volatility

vol_index_pctile_1y.bucket: low: 20th to 40th percentile of the past year

underlying_move_since_entry.bucket: favourable: price has moved in favour of the position since entry

position.short_strike_distance: close: within three quarters of an expected move of the short strike
position.pnl: small_gain: under one quarter of the maximum profit

time_to_expiry.bucket: four_weeks_or_more: about four weeks or more until expiry

position.entry_thesis: opened with trend up, implied volatility iv_rich versus realized, iv rank upper_middle, no tracked event inside the holding window
position.vol_exposure: short premium: profits from time passing and falling implied volatility
position.directional_exposure: neutral to bullish: profits if price stays above the short put strike

context.decision_session: near the close of the regular trading session
context.underlying_kind: broad US large-cap equity index ETF
